bills.title: Telecommunications and Other Legislation Amendment (Assistance and Access) Bill 2018

name: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2018-12-06.173.1) introduced by Senator [Mathias Cormann](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/wa/mathias_cormann), which means it succeeded. ### Motion text > *At the end of the motion, add:* > *"and the Parliamentary Joint Committee on Intelligence and Security conduct a review of the operation of the amendments made by this bill and report on that review by 3 April 2019."*
question: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2018-12-06.173.1) introduced by Senator [Mathias Cormann](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/wa/mathias_cormann), which means it succeeded. ### Motion text > *At the end of the motion, add:* > *"and the Parliamentary Joint Committee on Intelligence and Security conduct a review of the operation of the amendments made by this bill and report on that review by 3 April 2019."*
